nodes.label: Charter Type from Document ID Prefix
nodes.norm_label: charter type from document id prefix

properties.rationale: YAML configs allow adding/reordering/hiding columns and form fields with no code changes. Static export to GitHub Pages removes API routes; admin is unavailable on GitHub Pages.

OR logic within facets is standard behavior (Amazon, JSTOR, Zotero). Sidebar starts closed because the table is the primary view and competes for space on smaller screens. Global search uses simple substring matching — no indexing library needed for current corpus size.
Build-time computation is faster, deterministic, and keeps UI code simple. Client-side computation would cause a flash of unfiltered UI and add unnecessary JS execution.
Admin API routes are removed during static export because GitHub Pages does not support server-side routes. Admin is unavailable on GitHub Pages.
Embedded in admin dashboard to keep publish workflow co-located with document management. Curators already work in the dashboard; a separate page would add unnecessary navigation.

SSH key setup is complex and fragile for non-technical users. A fine-grained PAT with Contents:write permission is generatable via GitHub UI, requires no server-side config, and uses git remote set-url to override the remote to HTTPS with token.
User first sees git status preview of changes, then confirms with one click. Gives visibility into what will be published and prevents accidental publishes.

Token stored in data/.github-token (gitignored) instead of .env.local because Next.js loads env vars only at startup. A file read via fs.readFileSync is immediate and transparent without server restart.

Only one real XML file existed, making it impossible to test filters, pagination, sorting, or entity graph. A seeded generator creates 100 deterministic fake TEI XML documents using curated medieval Latin template pools and the existing xmlBuilder.ts code path.

The presence of data/fake/ is the sole toggle between fake and real mode. Self-documenting via ls, no config files or env vars, works consistently across CLI, dev server, and API routes. Alternative (ENV VAR SEMA_FAKE_MODE) rejected because it requires consistent setting across all processes.

Curated template pools for diplomatic clauses (invocatio, verba dispositiva, sanctio) with variable slots ($AUTHOR, $PLACE, $DATE). Faker cannot generate authentic medieval Latin formulas; charters are highly formulaic so 5-10 templates per clause type suffices.

The generation script builds FormSubmissionData objects and feeds them through generateTeiXml() from src/lib/xmlBuilder.ts. This tests the exact same code path as the admin form, guarantees valid TEI XML, and catches bugs in xmlBuilder.ts.

23 columns overwhelms the table with truncated body-text columns meant for detailed reading. Show only 11 metadata columns by default using an allowlist in columnVisibility initial state. Body-text columns remain toggleable via the Columns dropdown.

Charter type is not extracted from XML but encoded in document ID naming convention. Uses accessorFn calling getCharterTypeLabel(item.id, charterTypes) to derive the label, making it work with sorting/filtering without touching the data layer.

Global selection checkbox removed because the 20-document selection cap makes page-level select-all misleading. Replaced with row-click toggle (onClick on tr calling row.toggleSelected()). Preserves Compare/Graph/Export selection features.

Each facet section tracks its own isOpen state locally. Section open/close is a pure presentation concern; lifting to parent would add unnecessary prop drilling. Collapsed sections show (N selected) count for at-a-glance awareness of active filters.

Custom double-slider using two overlapping native HTML range inputs with CSS styling. No new dependencies needed. Alternative (react-slider or @radix-ui/react-slider) rejected to avoid adding a dependency for a single UI element.

Each facet value wrapped in a clickable button/div that toggles selection. The checkbox remains as visual indicator. Using a button as primary interaction makes it trivial to later add a second click action for entity detail views.

Curators non-technici (letterati, storici, archivisti) non possono usare la riga di comando per pubblicare. Il pannello embedded nella dashboard mostra lo stato git e permette publish con un click, con conferma a due fasi per evitare publish accidentali.

Server-side API route che esegue commit + push tramite child_process.exec. Scelto al posto di Octokit REST API perche usa comandi git standard facilmente debuggabili, e al posto di simple-git per evitare dipendenze npm aggiuntive.
Libreria in src/lib/git.ts che wrappa child_process.exec per eseguire git status, log, commit, push. Zero dipendenze esterne, comandi git standard.

Il token viene salvato in data/.github-token (gitignorato) invece che in .env.local perche Next.js carica le variabili d'ambiente solo all'avvio. Un file gitignorato letto via fs.readFileSync e immediato e trasparente, senza richiedere restart del server.

Usa un fine-grained Personal Access Token passato come https://x-access-token:${TOKEN}@github.com/... invece di SSH perche configurare chiavi SSH su una macchina per utenti non tecnici e complesso e fragile. Alternativa Octokit scartata perche richiede molto piu codice.
L'utente prima vede l'anteprima delle modifiche (status git), poi conferma con un click. Dare visibilita su cosa sara pubblicato prima di agire evita publish accidentali.

Con un solo documento TEI XML reale, impossibile testare filtri, paginazione, sorting e entity graph. Lo script genera 100 documenti fake deterministici per esercitare la UI e verificare la data pipeline con volume.

nodes.label: Fake Mode Toggle via Directory Presence

properties.rationale: La presenza di data/fake/ e l'unico toggle. Self-documenting: ls data/ mostra immediatamente la modalita. Nessun file di configurazione o variabile d'ambiente da gestire. Funziona consistentemente su CLI, dev server e API routes. Alternativa ENV VAR scartata perche richiede setting consistente su tutti i processi.

nodes.norm_label: fake mode toggle via directory presence

properties.rationale: Pattern in cui fs.existsSync(data/fake/) determina la modalita operativa. Usato da build scripts, API route e admin form per switchare directory di lettura/scrittura.

Lo script di generazione costruisce FormSubmissionData objects e li passa a generateTeiXml() da src/lib/xmlBuilder.ts. Testa lo stesso code path del form admin, garantisce struttura TEI XML valida, e riutilizza logica esistente per generazione filename e assegnazione ID.

nodes.label: Template Pools for Latin Diplomatic Text

properties.rationale: Pool curati di clausole diplomatiche medievali (invocatio, verba dispositiva, sanctio) con slot variabili ($AUTHOR, $PLACE, $DATE). Faker non puo generare latino medievale autentico; le carte sono altamente formulari, quindi 5-10 template per tipo di clausola sono sufficienti.

nodes.norm_label: template pools for latin diplomatic text

properties.rationale: Usa faker.seed(42) per output deterministico. Bug riproducibili: se un filtro si rompe con un dataset specifico, puoi rigenerarlo. CI deterministica. Facile da condividere: 'run npm run generate-fake -- --seed 123' da lo stesso corpus esatto.

19 delle 23 colonne sono testo diplomatico lungo per lettura dettagliata nel modal. La tabella dovrebbe mostrare metadata scansibili. Approccio allowlist (colonne visibili esplicite) piuttosto che denylist, cosi nuove colonne sono nascoste per default.

Il tipo di carta non e un campo estratto nell'XML — e codificato nella convenzione di naming del document ID (CH-IT_IV_1 → prefisso CH-IT → label 'Instrumentum venditionis'). accessorFn permette sorting e filtering senza toccare il data layer.

Il checkbox globale 'select all' e fuorviante con il cap di 20 documenti (seleziona al massimo 20 silenziosamente). La selezione esplicita per-documento tramite click sulla riga preserva le feature Compare/Graph/Export senza checkbox ingannevoli.

text-muted mappa alla variabile CSS --muted che e un colore di sfondo, non un colore di testo, causando contrasto insufficiente specialmente in dark mode. Approccio basato su foreground con opacita ridotta.

Con un corpus crescente, tutte e 5 le sezioni facet espanse creano una sidebar alta e scomoda che richiede troppo scrolling. Ogni sezione traccia il proprio stato isOpen internamente — concern puramente di presentazione, non serve lift al parent.

Due input range sovrapposti con position:absolute e z-index layering creano un double slider funzionale. Nessuna nuova dipendenza — librerie come react-slider scartate per evitare dependency per un singolo elemento UI.

Ogni valore facet wrappato in un button/div cliccabile che toggla la selezione. Il checkbox rimane come indicatore visivo. Usare button/div come superficie di interazione primaria rende triviale aggiungere in futuro un secondo click action per aprire dettagli entity.
Rispetta prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disabilitando tutte le animazioni expand/collapse. Accessibilita fondamentale per utenti con sensibilita al movimento.

nodes.label: Config-Driven Reverse Mapping for XML Parser

attributes.rationale: Avoids maintaining a separate mapping. When a new field is added to the form config, it automatically becomes parseable.

nodes.norm_label: config-driven reverse mapping for xml parser

attributes.rationale: This is a local-only tool. The filesystem is always writable. Simpler code, fewer bugs.

nodes.label: Full JSON Rebuild on Every Save

attributes.rationale: With ~500 documents, the build scripts take seconds. The simplicity of always consistent outweighs the performance cost.

nodes.norm_label: full json rebuild on every save

nodes.label: Windows Startup via Batch and PowerShell Scripts

attributes.rationale: Next.js dev server is the simplest path. A single .bat file reduces friction without requiring a complex executable build.

nodes.norm_label: windows startup via batch and powershell scripts

attributes.rationale: Reuses existing data. The JSON contains all document metadata including IDs, titles, dates, etc. No need to scan the filesystem directly.

nodes.label: Recursive Sections in Type System and YAML

attributes.rationale: Recursive is more natural for this domain. Flat with dot-notation IDs doesn't give visual nesting and makes YAML hard to read.

nodes.norm_label: recursive sections in type system and yaml

attributes.rationale: Two fields have different TEI mappings and different column behavior. Keeping them as separate FormFieldConfig entries preserves the existing field processing pipeline.
Hardcoding witness-specific logic is not reusable. The exclusiveOption approach keeps the component generic.
Matches existing Columns menu pattern, zero extra dependencies. Simple toggle popover with two buttons.
The header height is known and consistent. CSS-only approach with calc(100vh - header-height) is simpler than JS resize observer.
Transform side-by-side layout from per-document columns to a grid where each row corresponds to a section. Cells in the same row share the same height, naturally aligning sections.

properties.rationale: Using form-sections.yaml as single source of truth for both form rendering and XML parsing avoids maintaining a separate mapping. When a new field is added to config, it automatically becomes parseable.
Removes two separate export buttons (CSV/JSON) from toolbar, replacing with a single button with format selector dropdown to reduce clutter
Table lacks fixed viewport causing scroll-position jumps; wrapper uses calc(100vh - header) with overflow-y:auto to keep scrollbar visible
Graph View button visible even when no documents selected is meaningless; hide when selectedCount is 0
Side-by-side comparison sections are misaligned making comparison difficult; restructure to per-section grid where each row represents one section type with equal-height cells
Clicking View on documents sometimes shows truncated content instead of full text; ensure longTextConfig columns render complete text without ellipsis
Derive charter type label from document ID prefix using charterTypes array from corpus metadata; always visible, not toggleable
Show only 11 metadata columns by default, hide 19 body-text/clause columns; user can toggle via Columns menu
Generate configurable number of fake TEI P5 XML documents with realistic medieval metadata pools and formulaic Latin body text for testing
Auto-detect fake mode from presence of data/fake/ directory; build scripts and admin form transparently use active directory
Remove header checkbox for selecting all rows; per-row selection triggered by clicking on table row itself with 20-document cap
Pagination controls use visible text color with sufficient contrast (≥4.5:1) against background in both light and dark modes

properties.description: SVG of the Vercel brand logo - an upward-pointing white triangle on transparent background. This is the deployment platform logo associated with Next.js.
A small SVG icon depicting a browser/application window frame with three control dots (close, minimize, maximize) in the title bar. Used as a UI element in the Sema application.
